verses.sloka: तच्छ्रुत्वा भाषितं तस्य रामस्याक्लिष्ट कर्मणः ।द्वास्स्थः कुमारावाहूय राघवाय न्यवेदयत् ।। ७.८३.१ ॥
verses.transliteration: tacchrutvā bhāṣitaṁ tasya rāmasyākliṣṭa karmaṇaḥ ।dvāssthaḥ kumārāvāhūya rāghavāya nyavedayat ।। 7.83.1 ॥

translations.english: Having heard the words of Rama, whose deeds were effortless, the doorkeeper called the two princes and announced their arrival to Raghava.

verses.sloka: दृष्ट्वा तु राघवः प्राप्तौ प्रियौ भरतलक्ष्मणौ ।परिष्वज्य तदा रामो वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.८३.२ ॥
verses.transliteration: dṛṣṭvā tu rāghavaḥ prāptau priyau bharatalakṣmaṇau ।pariṣvajya tadā rāmo vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.83.2 ॥

translations.english: And when Raghava saw his dear Bharata and Lakshmana arrive, Rama embraced them and then spoke these words.
translations.hindi: शत्रुघ्न जी ने पू छा-हे सुने ! उसके त्रिशूल में क्या विशेषता है ? उस शूल से युद्ध में ( आज तक ) कितने लोग मारे गए-हेँ? कौन कोन लोग उस शूत् से इन्द्युद्ध करने के आ चुके हैं ?

verses.sloka: कृतं मया यथा तथ्यं द्विजकार्यमनुत्तमम् ।धर्मसेतुमथो भूयः कर्तुमिच्छामि राघवौ ।। ७.८३.३ ॥
verses.transliteration: kṛtaṁ mayā yathā tathyaṁ dvijakāryamanuttamam ।dharmasetumatho bhūyaḥ kartumicchāmi rāghavau ।। 7.83.3 ॥

translations.english: O Raghavas, I have truly and excellently performed the duty of a Brahmin, and now I wish to further establish a bridge of righteousness.
translations.hindi: महाबली शत्र घ्न जो के उस दचन को सुन, महातेजस्वी च्यवन >) जी ने उनसे कहा

verses.sloka: अक्षय्यश्चाव्ययश्चैव धर्मसेतुर्मतो मम ।धर्मप्रसाधकं ह्येतत् सर्वपापप्रणाशनम् ।। ७.८३.४ ॥
verses.transliteration: akṣayyaścāvyayaścaiva dharmaseturmato mama ।dharmaprasādhakaṁ hyetat sarvapāpapraṇāśanam ।। 7.83.4 ॥

translations.english: This bridge of righteousness is considered by me to be imperishable and immutable, for it indeed accomplishes dharma and destroys all sins.
translations.hindi: हे रघुनन्दन ! इस शूल से असंख्य काम हुए हैं; किन्तु इस शूल द्वारा इच्वाकुकुलोत्पन्न (.मान्धाता ) के विषय में, जो घटना घटी थी, उसका वृत्तान्त तुम सुनो

verses.sloka: युवाभ्यामात्मभूताभ्यां राजसूयमनुत्तमम् ।सहितो यष्टुमिच्छामि तत्र धर्मो हि शाश्वतः ।। ७.८३.५ ॥
verses.transliteration: yuvābhyāmātmabhūtābhyāṁ rājasūyamanuttamam ।sahito yaṣṭumicchāmi tatra dharmo hi śāśvataḥ ।। 7.83.5 ॥

translations.english: I wish to perform the excellent Rajasuya sacrifice together with both of you, who are like my own self, for indeed, the dharma achieved through it is eternal.
translations.hindi: हे राजन्‌ ! पूर्वकाल में, महा राज युवनाश्व के पुत्र महाबलवान मान्धाता हुए । यह त्रिलोकी में अपने पराक्रम के लिए प्रसिद्ध ' ये

verses.sloka: इष्ट्वा तु राजसूयेन मित्रः शत्रुनिबर्हणः ।सुहुतेन सुयज्ञेन वरुणत्वमुपागमत् ।। ७.८३.६ ॥
verses.transliteration: iṣṭvā tu rājasūyena mitraḥ śatrunibarhaṇaḥ ।suhutena suyajñena varuṇatvamupāgamat ।। 7.83.6 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, Mitra, the destroyer of enemies, attained the state of Varuna by performing the well-offered and good Rajasuya sacrifice.
translations.hindi: इन्होंने सम्पूर्ण प्रथिवीमरडल को अपने चश. में करके, अर्थात्‌ जीत कर, स्वर्ग लोक के विजय करने का आयोजन किआ था

verses.sloka: सोमश्च राजसूयेन इष्ट्वा धर्मेण धर्मवित् ।प्राप्तश्च सर्वलोकेषु कीर्तिस्थानं च शाश्वतम् ।। ७.८३.७ ॥
verses.transliteration: somaśca rājasūyena iṣṭvā dharmeṇa dharmavit ।prāptaśca sarvalokeṣu kīrtisthānaṁ ca śāśvatam ।। 7.83.7 ॥

translations.english: And Soma, the knower of dharma, having righteously performed the Rajasuya sacrifice, attained an eternal place of fame in all worlds.
translations.hindi: जब महाराज मान्धाता ने स्वर्ग जीतने की तैयारियाँ कीं, तब महाबली इन्द्रादि समस्त देवता बहुत घवड़ाए ओर भयभीत हुए

verses.sloka: अस्मिन्नहनि यच्छ्रेयश्चिन्त्यतां तन्मया सह ।हितं चायतियुक्तं च प्रयतौ कर्तुमर्हथः ।। ७.८३.८ ॥
verses.transliteration: asminnahani yacchreyaścintyatāṁ tanmayā saha ।hitaṁ cāyatiyuktaṁ ca prayatau kartumarhathaḥ ।। 7.83.8 ॥

translations.english: Let whatever is good and beneficial, leading to future prosperity, be thought about by me together with you on this day, and both of you ought to strive to accomplish it.

verses.sloka: श्रुत्वा तु राघवस्यैतद्वाक्यं वाक्यविशारदः ।भरतः प्राञ्जलिर्भूत्वा वाक्यमेतदुवाच ह ।। ७.८३.९ ॥
verses.transliteration: śrutvā tu rāghavasyaitadvākyaṁ vākyaviśāradaḥ ।bharataḥ prāñjalirbhūtvā vākyametaduvāca ha ।। 7.83.9 ॥

translations.english: Indeed, having heard this speech of Rama, Bharata, who was skilled in speech, spoke these words with folded hands.

verses.sloka: त्वयि धर्मः परः साधो त्वयि सर्वा वसुन्धरा ।प्रतिष्ठिता महाबाहो यशश्चामितविक्रम ।। ७.८३.१० ॥
verses.transliteration: tvayi dharmaḥ paraḥ sādho tvayi sarvā vasundharā ।pratiṣṭhitā mahābāho yaśaścāmitavikrama ।। 7.83.10 ॥

translations.english: O righteous one, supreme dharma resides in you; O mighty-armed one, the entire earth is established in you; and O one of immeasurable valor, fame also rests in you.
translations.hindi: हे पुरुषश्रेष्ठ ! तुम अभी तक तो समस्त प्रथिवी का राज्य ही अपने हस्तगत नहीं कर पाए। सम्पूर्ण प्रथिवी का राज्य अपने अधीन किए बिना आप देवराज्य को हस्तगत करने की इच्छा किस प्रकार करते हैं

verses.sloka: महीपालाश्च सर्वे त्वां प्रजापतिमिवामराः ।निरीक्षन्ते महात्मानं लोकानाथं यथा वयम् ।। ७.८३.११ ॥
verses.transliteration: mahīpālāśca sarve tvāṁ prajāpatimivāmarāḥ ।nirīkṣante mahātmānaṁ lokānāthaṁ yathā vayam ।। 7.83.11 ॥

translations.english: All kings, like gods regarding Prajapati, look upon you, the great-souled one and lord of the worlds, just as we do.
translations.hindi: हे बीर ! यदि सम्पूर्ण प्रथिवी तुम्हारे बश में हो गई हो तो नौकर चाकर, फौज ओर बाहनों सहित देवलोक में तुम राज्य करो

verses.sloka: पुत्राश्च पितृवद्राजन्पश्यन्ति त्वां महाबल ।पृथिव्या गतिभूतो ऽसि प्राणिनामपि राघव ।। ७.८३.१२ ॥
verses.transliteration: putrāśca pitṛvadrājanpaśyanti tvāṁ mahābala ।pṛthivyā gatibhūto 'si prāṇināmapi rāghava ।। 7.83.12 ॥

translations.english: O King, O mighty-armed one, your sons regard you as a father, and you are indeed the refuge for all living beings on earth, O Raghava.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र के इस प्रकार कहने पर, मान्धाता बोले-हे इन्द्र ! बत- लाओ तो प्रथिबीतल पर मेरी आज्ञा का पालन कहाँ नहीं होता

verses.sloka: स त्वमेवंविधं यज्ञमाहर्तासि कथं नृप ।पृथिव्यां राजवंशानां विनाशो यत्र दृश्यते ।। ७.८३.१३ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvamevaṁvidhaṁ yajñamāhartāsi kathaṁ nṛpa ।pṛthivyāṁ rājavaṁśānāṁ vināśo yatra dṛśyate ।। 7.83.13 ॥

translations.english: O King, how can you perform such a sacrifice where the destruction of royal lineages on earth is foreseen?
translations.hindi: तमुवाच सहस्राक्षो लवणो नाम राक्षसः । मधुपुत्रो मधुवने न तेञज्ञां कुरुतेऽनघ !!१३॥ इस पर इन्द्र ने कहा--हे अनघ ! मधुवन में सघुदैत्य का पुत्र लवशासुर तुम्हारी आज्ञा का पालन नहीं करता

verses.sloka: पृथिव्यां ये च पुरुषा राजन्पौरुषमागताः ।सर्वेषां भविता तत्र सङ्क्षयः सर्वकोपजः ।। ७.८३.१४ ॥
verses.transliteration: pṛthivyāṁ ye ca puruṣā rājanpauruṣamāgatāḥ ।sarveṣāṁ bhavitā tatra saṅkṣayaḥ sarvakopajaḥ ।। 7.83.14 ॥

translations.english: O King, all men on earth who have attained valor will face destruction there, born of universal wrath.
translations.hindi: इन्द्र के कहे हुए इन घोर अप्रिय वचनों का सुन, मान्धाता ने लज्जित हो नीचे के! मुख कर लिआ और इन्द्र के कुछ भी उत्तर न दै, मान्धाता इन्द्र से बिदा हो, नीचा मुख किए हुए पुनः भूमण्डल पर आए

verses.sloka: स त्वं पुरुषशार्दूल गुणैरतुलविक्रम ।पृथिवीं नार्हसे हन्तुं वशे हि तव वर्तते ।। ७.८३.१५ ॥
verses.transliteration: sa tvaṁ puruṣaśārdūla guṇairatulavikrama ।pṛthivīṁ nārhase hantuṁ vaśe hi tava vartate ।। 7.83.15 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, O one of unequalled valor by your virtues, you ought not to destroy the earth, for it is indeed under your control.

verses.sloka: भरतस्य तु तद्वाक्यं श्रुत्वा ऽमृतमयं तदा ।प्रहर्षमतुलं लेभे रामः सत्यपराक्रमः ।। ७.८३.१६ ॥
verses.transliteration: bharatasya tu tadvākyaṁ śrutvā 'mṛtamayaṁ tadā ।praharṣamatulaṁ lebhe rāmaḥ satyaparākramaḥ ।। 7.83.16 ॥

translations.english: Then, Rama, whose valor was true, having heard that nectar-like speech of Bharata, obtained incomparable great joy.
translations.hindi: उसके मर में कोध तो भरा हुआ था ही, अतः वे कट सेना अर वाहनों के साथ ले कर, लवणासुर के वश में करने की इच्छा से उस पर चढ़ गए

verses.sloka: उवाच च शुभं वाक्यं कैकेय्यानन्दवर्धनम् ।प्रीतो ऽस्मि परितुष्टो ऽस्मि तवाद्य वचने ऽनघ ।। ७.८३.१७ ॥
verses.transliteration: uvāca ca śubhaṁ vākyaṁ kaikeyyānandavardhanam ।prīto 'smi parituṣṭo 'smi tavādya vacane 'nagha ।। 7.83.17 ॥

translations.english: And he spoke auspicious words that increased Kaikeyi's joy, saying, "O sinless one, I am pleased and completely satisfied with your words today."

verses.sloka: इदं वचनमक्लीबं त्वया धर्मसमाहितम् ।व्याहृतं पुरुषव्याघ्र पृथिव्याः परिपालनम् ।। ७.८३.१८ ॥
verses.transliteration: idaṁ vacanamaklībaṁ tvayā dharmasamāhitam ।vyāhṛtaṁ puruṣavyāghra pṛthivyāḥ paripālanam ।। 7.83.18 ॥

translations.english: O tiger among men, this firm speech, imbued with righteousness and concerning the protection of the earth, has been spoken by you.

verses.sloka: एष्यदस्मदभिप्रायाद्राजसूयात्क्रतूत्तमात् ।निवर्तयामि धर्मज्ञ तव सुव्याहृतेन च ।। ७.८३.१९ ॥
verses.transliteration: eṣyadasmadabhiprāyādrājasūyātkratūttamāt ।nivartayāmi dharmajña tava suvyāhṛtena ca ।। 7.83.19 ॥

translations.english: O knower of dharma, I desist from the impending Rajasuya, the best of sacrifices, which was our intention, because of your well-spoken words.

verses.sloka: लोकपीडाकरं कर्म न कर्तव्यं विचक्षणैः ।बालानां तु शुभं वाक्यं ग्राह्य लक्ष्मणपूर्वज ।तस्माच्छृणोमि ते वाक्यं साधु युक्तं महामते ।। ७.८३.२० ।।
verses.transliteration: lokapīḍākaraṁ karma na kartavyaṁ vicakṣaṇaiḥ ।bālānāṁ tu śubhaṁ vākyaṁ grāhya lakṣmaṇapūrvaja ।tasmācchṛṇomi te vākyaṁ sādhu yuktaṁ mahāmate ।। 7.83.20 ।।

translations.english: Wise people should not perform actions that cause distress to others, and indeed, O elder brother of Lakshmana, even the auspicious words of younger ones should be accepted; therefore, O great-minded one, I listen to your good and appropriate speech. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे त्र्यशीतितमः सर्गः ।। 83 ।। Thus ends the eighty-third sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
translations.hindi: तब उस राक्षस ने ( शिव का दिआ हुआ ) उत्तम शूल उठाया ओर अट्टहास कर, ' महाराज के! सेना सहित मारने के लिए उस, शूत्र के फेका
